candidate_sentence_map.S13: The company also received an order for long-lead components for the EPS-Sterna weather constellation and began assembly of its first VIREON™ Earth Observation satellites.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: The Sedna-1 and Sedna-2 satellites became fully operational, strengthening the maritime data network.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: To support these investments and ensure liquidity, the company completed two directed share issues, raising approximately SEK 174.8 million before transaction costs.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: Notably, Bonnier Capital became a major shareholder through a strategic investment.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: The equity ratio improved to 80 percent from 71 percent, indicating a strengthened balance sheet despite the operational losses.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: Order backlog stood at SEK 352 million at year-end, though the CEO noted that a major contract awarded in early 2026 would significantly increase this figure.
